name: review-channels
description: Independent second-opinion review: send one document to several external AI models at once and mechanically verify each one did the research instead of inventing sources.

plugins.name: model-orchestration
plugins.description: Run one brief past several external reviewer models in parallel (Spark, Codex, Gemini/Antigravity, Kimi, Qwen), show where they disagree, and mechanically verify each one actually opened the sources it cited.
